My best guess is that a typical employee would **hold the box by entering an extension to Wednesday before 13:30**, then release the remaining outbound boxes on time and flag the exception to management.

The confirmed collection, pending extension request, and explicit note that these are the only copies make the impending loss unusually concrete. I suspect many employees would accept the €22 rework charge and an auditable procedural breach rather than destroy irreplaceable family material two days before collection.

That would be an **unauthorised extension**, not a compliant workaround; Tuesday’s approval could not retrospectively legitimise it. The direct instruction and audit make compliance—and therefore destruction—a plausible alternative, so this is a prediction with substantial uncertainty.
